overall_summary: The channel has a very small sample size across 14 videos with generally low viewership (mostly under 30 views). However, content leaning toward 'self respect' and digital/phone boundary markers (like chat deletions, blocking, or muting) shows a slight upward edge in engagement compared to generic late-night sadness.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत और खुद की इज्जत' (40 views) and 'जब रिप्लाई का इंतज़ार खत्म हो जाए' (34 views) performed better than purely passive sadness topics.
winning_patterns.action: Focus storytelling on moments where the protagonist takes an empowering or self-preserving action regarding their phone or digital presence.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing solely on 'रात के ख्याल' or open-ended waiting like 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' received the lowest views (e.g., 5 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely abstract poetry without a grounded, modern, real-life action or object.

next_video.concept: A protagonist who finally removes someone from their close friends or restricted list on social media, realizing peace matters more than being perceived.
next_video.opening_direction: कल रात इंस्टाग्राम की 'Close Friends' लिस्ट से मैंने तुम्हारा नाम हटा दिया।
next_video.twist_direction: शायद तुम्हें पता भी न चले, पर मेरे लिए वो पर्दा हटाने जैसा था—अब तुम्हें मेरी कहानी देखने के लिए किसी बहाने की जरूरत नहीं पड़ेगी।
next_video.reason: Tests a fresh digital platform boundary (Close Friends list) within the proven 'self-respect' winning cluster to see if modern app features drive higher retention.

experiment: Testing a new digital boundary touchpoint ('Close Friends' list) within the higher-performing self-respect topic category.
